summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, announcing an increase in the regular dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD) from 13.00% to 14.00%, effective for periods beginning November 1, 2026. The board's dividend committee also declared daily cash dividends of $0.00614 per share for the November 1-30, 2026 period, covering 19 business days and aggregating approximately $184,469. No transaction, solicitation, or strategic review is involved, making this a routine capital-return-rate adjustment rather than a special situation.
